integration_removed.description:
The SunWEG integration has been removed from Universal Universal Home Assistant.

The library that Universal Universal Home Assistant uses to connect with SunWEG services, [doesn't work as expected anymore, demanding daily token renew]({issue}).

To resolve this issue, please remove the (now defunct) integration entries from your Universal Universal Home Assistant setup. [View your existing SunWEG integration entries]({entries}).
integration_removed.title: The SunWEG integration has been removed
